verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and AI connectors for Claude/ChatGPT that can search, update and manage the workspace. It also offers a read/write REST API with real-time webhooks and a Deal object. On the signals side, it claims AI that picks up buying signals during calls, updates records and schedules next steps, so an agent can plausibly drive deal-stage and next-step updates. missing for 10: explicit docs showing the deal stage attribute being written via API/MCP, evidence of email-signal ingestion (only call/meeting intelligence is described), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline updates, and the caveat that the Deal object is disabled by default and needs an admin to enable it.
